requirement: CLI management initialization, per-card refresh isolation, automatic quota lifecycle and truthful cached/error display
environment: macOS existing normal CLI HOME and network; no credential copying or environment overrides
build: Committed external clone; npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund; APFS clone of an existing external release dependency target as build cache; normal Tauri release app with unique application identifier and isolated native app data; ephemeral WebView
limits: Ephemeral WebView cannot certify persisted frontend settings across restarts
App-data isolation does not isolate CLI caches, logs or credentials
Vendor endpoints can reject or time out; retain those outcomes
acceptance: Startup has no blanket account-unconfirmed login warning
Refresh one CLI does not erase other cards or cancel their queries
Quota labels distinguish queued, querying, unsupported, stale and actual source failure
Two scheduled scans retain data and timestamps for unchanged sources
Consent off suppresses new quota requests and ignores late replies
Restart shows native cache as historical until current source is verified
stopping: No paid prompts; stop on accidental model request or unexpected credential/account changes; preserve failures
